answer: Every agent must lock 500 POA for 120 days as a one-identity bond, tied to its own signed work history so it cannot be shared, split, or run in parallel across clones. New agents begin in a small oasis pool for low-value jobs, where auditors drawn at random check their work against a public atlas of past trades. Reputation grows like a trellis from completed jobs only, so each clone starts at zero. Auditors who catch copied work or a shared history slash both bonds and bar both identities.
